name: All-Terrain Vehicle
description: A motorized vehicle designed for cross-country travel over land, snow, ice or other natural terrain, including a pedal bicycle with a motor attached; the territory has no e-bike class, so an e-bike lands here, as does an electric dirt bike like a Sur-Ron or Talaria.

restrictions.rule: Runs on wheels, tracks, skis or air cushions and includes a pedal bicycle with a motor attached; nothing over 900 kg; no limit on motor power or speed
restrictions.citation: All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, s. 1(1)

restrictions.rule: Not a motor vehicle under the Motor Vehicles Act; the territory's registration, plate and helmet rules, and all its age rules but the under-16 road ban, apply only to three- and four-wheeled special all-terrain vehicles
restrictions.citation: Motor Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. M-16, s. 1; All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, ss. 1(1) and 9.03 to 9.08

restrictions.rule: Outside a municipality or regulated area, kept off roadways and shoulders except to cross one, or to travel a seasonal ice or snow road with liability insurance where no other route is practicable; riders under 16 may do neither
restrictions.citation: All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, s. 2

restrictions.rule: On a roadway it keeps close to the right-hand edge, not abreast of other vehicles, with no more riders than it's built for, and its driver has a motor vehicle driver's duties
restrictions.citation: All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, s. 3(1) and (4)
All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, s. 3(2)

restrictions.rule: Needs a working brake on a roadway, and a white headlight and red tail light on a highway at night
restrictions.citation: All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, s. 3(6) and (7)

restrictions.rule: Municipalities, and regulated areas through territorial regulations, may require registration, operator licences, insurance and equipment, set age and speed limits, and restrict where it's ridden; those rules prevail over the Act's
restrictions.citation: All-terrain Vehicles Act, R.S.N.W.T. 1988, c. A-3, ss. 3(3), 4, 5, 6 and 17

restrictions.rule: The Registrar may register one under the Motor Vehicles Act, which then treats it as a motor vehicle
restrictions.citation: All-terrain Vehicles Regulations, R.R.N.W.T. 1990, c. A-1, ss. 2 to 5
